title: Lane lint reads the checks job in degen, joyous and ios-adblock
why: Runner 9 measured `ci-job checks --lint` at 22:54 CST Nov 7: rc 2 in degen (its workflow is check.yml), joyous (checks.yml has no job `checks`) and ios-adblock (its workflow is ci.yml). It blocks the release of #1760, which prints a review record only after lane lint reads the job.
note: The fix is in each repo's workflow shape, not a second form in the tool. Ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
